text:
ryan: Heads-up — running a performance benchmark for Lumicore tomorrow 9:00am PT. Need a 30m steady window at ~700 qps and a 2k qps burst for ~90s. Model: redwood-2.7b-q4. Can eng reserve capacity and share a ballpark cost? cc @maya @sam

maya: I can own the runbook + one-slide SLA. Hosted OK for POC? Any sensitive prompts?

ryan: Hosted OK, no PHI.

sam: I recommend reserving 3 A100-equivalent devices with autoscale headroom. Ill book them for a 1h slot (we book 1h min).

lia: Observability checklist: p50/p95/p99, queue length, GPU util, kv-cache hits, error rate. Make sure requests include run_id for trace correlation.

maya: Ramp plan (short): warm 00m @100 qps, ramp to 700 over 3m, 2k burst ~90s, sustain 30m, cool-down 5m. Randomize prompt length around 60 tokens.

sam: Napkin cost: 3 devices * 1h ~ $1800 (internal rate). Token estimate ~340M => ~$1000. Rough total ~$2800. Ill send the spreadsheet with exact calc.

ryan: Acceptance criteria: p95 < 250ms, p99 < 600ms, errors < 1%, throughput within +/-10%. If we miss, plan to fallback to a smaller quantized variant. @sam please drop runbook + SLA slide by EOD.

sam: Will drop runbook and slide in sales folder and tag this thread.
